findings.lens: performance — the builder's declared blind spot, measured
findings.claim_refuted: REFUTED AS STATED. The builder wrote: '🔴 ביצועי report_m04_discounts ו-report_m06_staffing מעולם לא נמדדו כמכלול, ושתיהן בנויות בדפוס שמתנפח בשקט… אם אחד מהם חוצה ~1 שניה — התיקון ידוע'. Neither is anywhere near 1 s, and BOTH named mechanisms are the wrong suspects.
findings.evidence: `explain (analyze, timing)` run as an impersonated FINANCE identity (set_config('request.jwt.claims','{"email":"finance.test@regin.co.il"}') in the same statement, so assert_module_permission passes). report_m04_discounts(null, date'2026-09-10') = **187.300 ms**, second run **181.560 ms**. report_m06_staffing(null, date'2026-09-10') = **36.374 ms**, second run **34.271 ms**. For context: report_m02_exec_overview('2026-01-01','2026-09-10') = 183.593 ms · report_m03_trends(null,'2026-09-10') = 157.543 ms. SUSPECT (ב) — m6's correlated `count(*)` on assignments per project, '736 runs against a 5,741-row table' — costs almost nothing: m6 is the FASTEST of the four at 34 ms, and it is the only one that never calls finance_project_money(). SUSPECT (א) — the 16 correlated scalar subqueries in m4's `by_tier` — is ~38 ms of m4's 182 ms: I timed the `events` CTE alone and it is **143.956 ms**, of which the Function Scan on finance_project_money is `actual time=0.190 rows=1 loops=731` ⇒ 139 ms. So 79 % of m4's runtime is the per-project money lateral, not `by_tier`.
findings.what_to_record_instead: The scaling line belongs to `finance_project_money()`, is shared by מ2·מ3·מ4 (and the finance tab), and is linear in the event count: ~0.190 ms per project × 731 today. At ~5,000 events the three pages cross ~1 s together. The builder's proposed rewrite (`group by tier` + left join) buys ~38 ms on one page and would not move that line. Iron rule 14 makes the lateral the SSOT, so this is a record-it item, not a fix-it item.
